rows.grounds: compound of praṇata (bowed), ārtti (distress), and hara (remover)

items.question: Which compassionate, effective, and sovereign attributes further define this accomplished figure?
premises: The figure removes distress of those who bow.
The figure is an articulate speaker.
The figure holds lordship over people.
items.inference: This figure combines compassion, eloquence, efficacy, and sovereignty.
items.plain_english: He removes the distress of those who bow, is an eloquent speaker, has accomplished his tasks, and is the lord of people.
